Picoline addition induces cluster dissolution

(picoline)
Output: Main-reported BBN-SH:picoline-containing state after addition to preformed cluster
Main reports cluster dissolution and formation of BBN-SH:picoline after adding picoline to the
preformed cluster. This is a separate qualitative observation; amounts, solvent, temperature,
duration, vessel and isolation are unavailable in the admitted main statement. The cited SI
experiment is unread.
Qualitative reagent-action diagram only; no vessel, reaction conditions, atomic coordination
or measured cluster geometry is reported or reconstructed.
